'''2022 MPC Lenny Rubin DS SYCFA''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Lenny Rubin]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Lenny Rubin]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open SYCFA Rubin DS 2022 MPC 2.txt |Download]]
